necessity_paragraph: The claim for CPT 93229 was denied under code PR-204, but the service is medically necessary for the patient with diagnosis codes R55 and I48.91. The clinical indication note states the patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope in the setting of known atrial fibrillation. Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and guide further management of rate control and anticoagulation therapy.
